name: GPT-Live-Transcribe
access: OpenAI API (Realtime transcription sessions: WebSocket, WebRTC)

voice.input_audio: Streaming audio appended with input_audio_buffer.append (the guide example uses 24 kHz PCM); text context through prompt and keywords [openai-guide-transcription-rt]
voice.turn_detection: None: turn_detection must be omitted or null; the model supports neither server_vad nor semantic_vad, and the client sends input_audio_buffer.commit at the end of each audio turn, with client-side VAD if wanted [openai-guide-transcription-rt] [openai-guide-vad]
voice.interruption: Not applicable: the model transcribes and does not speak
voice.latency: Artificial Analysis streaming benchmark: 0.26 s to the first partial transcript and 0.81 s to the final transcript after speech ends; OpenAI's guide says latency is tunable with audio.input.transcription.delay from minimal to xhigh and gives no figure per level; the API reference says delay is supported only with gpt-realtime-whisper [aa-stt-streaming] [openai-guide-transcription-rt] [openai-ref-client-secrets]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: $0.017 per minute of audio; billed by duration, not by tokens

benchmarks.name: AA-WER Streaming Index (Artificial Analysis, final transcripts, percent, lower is better)
benchmarks.setting: datasets AA-AgentTalk, VoxPopuli, Earnings22; delay setting not stated
